newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to hold 4-year note auction on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to hold 4-year note auction on Tuesday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will hold a four-year government note auction on Tuesday, a ministry official said on Monday.
The ministry plans no other auctions this week, the MOF official said.

Traders said the offering volume for the four-year note auction is likely to be 500 billion yen, the same as for the previous note auction. The coupon rate is likely to be set at either 1.1 or 1.2 percent, they said.
When the MOF last auctioned four-year notes on February 4, it offered 500 billion yen worth of the notes, which carried a coupon rate of 1.1 percent.
